prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished original hunter-equipment DESIGN BOARD for the same original fantasy world as the supplied reference. The reference is a STYLE AND MATERIAL-RENDERING guide only; do not reproduce its monster, scenery or rock-armor design.
Landscape composition, warm ivory background, refined realistic hand-painted game concept art, soft neutral light. No environment or monsters. Sharp metal, fiber and leather textures, believable joints and construction.
EXACT CONTENT: one full-body adult neutral mannequin wearing a complete five-part armor set at left (helmet, torso, pair of forearm guards, short waist protection, pair of leg guards). Empty relaxed hands, no weapons attached to the mannequin. Head and both boots entirely within frame, generous margins. Practical and modest, no heroic crown or enormous horns, knees/elbows/wrists free.
On the right, SEVEN carefully separated numbered weapon groups in a clear two-row display: 01 large broad two-handed cleaver sword, 02 short SINGLE-EDGE sword WITH SEPARATE SMALL SHIELD, 03 heavy closed SOLID-BONE/METAL MALLET head on a long handle (no drum membrane), 04 TWO matching short blades, 05 slender long curved SINGLE-EDGE sword, 06 a straight LONG SPEAR WITH SEPARATE LARGE SHIELD, 07 an actual BOW WITH ONE VISIBLE STRING, SMALL aiming ring and ONE separate arrow. All seven groups must appear, no duplicates or substitutions, no objects hidden behind the mannequin. Weapons separated, fully visible, no cropping or intersecting silhouettes.
ARMOR DESIGN: 年輪の線を見せた細い積木板。太い根をそのまま肩へ載せず、曲げ木で体に沿わせる。
Five parts: 額の低い曲木輪へ短い頭頂板を二枚。顔は開ける。 / 左右三枚ずつの曲木胸板。腹は柔らかい根繊維でつなぐ。 / 前腕外側に弓状の木片二本。肘と手首の間に余白。 / 腰骨に沿う小板と、後ろの短い道具留め。 / 細い木の脛当てを二枚分割し、膝は独立した丸板。
MATERIAL PALETTE: 灰褐色 / 苔緑 / 革の焦茶. Use the native beginner version: 細い曲木板と根紐。刃先だけ採掘鉄。
WEAPON DETAILS (keep seven distinct functional silhouettes):
01: 幅広く厚い片刃。採掘鉄の刃を持つ根材の積層芯を芯に、峰から鍔へ曲げ木の浅いアーチを沿わせる。刃先は斜めに切り、握りを直線にする。
02: 短い片刃剣と独立した小盾。剣の峰と盾の外縁へ曲げ木の浅いアーチ。盾は裏側の横握りを備え、剣と一体化しない。
03: 柄の先に閉じた二つの硬い打面。採掘鉄の刃を持つ根材の積層芯の重い芯を曲げ木の浅いアーチで囲う。太鼓膜・斧刃・開いた籠にはしない。
04: 同形の短い片刃を二本。曲げ木の浅いアーチを両方の背へ小さく付け、片方を盾や長剣にしない。
05: 細く浅く反った片刃。曲げ木の浅いアーチは峰に低く沿わせ、長い切刃を連続させる。柄は両手を離して置ける長さ。
06: 直線の長槍と独立した縦長の大盾。槍先は細い穂、盾面は曲げ木の浅いアーチを縦に並べる。槍を大剣や薙刀にしない。
07: 細い弓身、一本の弦、小さな照準環、別に一本の矢。曲げ木の浅いアーチを弓身へ低く沿わせる。円盤や環状の近接刃にはしない。
Only the small numerals 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07 may be printed beside the seven weapon groups. Absolutely no heading, title, name, Japanese writing, rank text, decorative writing, watermark, logo, measurements or legend. This is a design comparison illustration, not a dimensioned orthographic drawing. Do not copy any existing commercial game IP.
FRAMING OVERRIDE: every object must fit inside the central 84% of the canvas. Leave at least 8% blank margin on ALL FOUR SIDES, especially above the large sword and spear points. Reduce subject scale rather than touching or crossing image boundaries. All sword tips, helmet, bow limbs and boot soles must be fully visible.
